notes.title: Version 1.0.03
notes.notes:
Greetings dear players,

We have fixed some issues due to your feedbacks:

Shaving Kovalev is easier.
Fixing bug related to crowd that watches dancing chairs.
Fix some typo and syntax errors.
Adding tag for player when map is opened, so you can see where you are on player.

We are considering all feedbacks and bug reports as soon as possible and 	appreciate all reporters that help us to improve The Nose.
